entries.question: How do I reset my password?
entries.answer:
To reset your password:
1. Open https://selfservice.acme.example/reset in a browser [1].
2. Enter your employee email address [1].
3. Approve the verification request in your authenticator app, or type the 6-digit code shown there [1].
4. Enter a new password twice and click Submit [1].
5. Wait 5 minutes, then sign in again on all devices [1].

Your new password must be at least 12 characters long

entries.question: My account is locked after too many wrong attempts
entries.answer: After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account locks for 30 minutes and unlocks automatically [1]. To unlock sooner, you can use the self-service reset page or contact the IT Service Desk [1]. If your account stays locked after 30 minutes or you suspect someone else accessed your account, please escalate to the Security team [2].

entries.question: What are the password requirements?
entries.answer: The new password must be at least 12 characters long and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol. It cannot match any of your last 5 passwords and cannot contain your name or employee ID [1].

entries.question: VPN says authentication failed
entries.answer: To troubleshoot a VPN authentication failed error: 1. Check that your password has not expired and that you typed the newest 6-digit code [1]. 2. If codes keep failing, set your phone to automatic date and time, as wrong clock settings cause rejected codes [1]. 3. If your password was reset recently, wait 5 minutes and try again [1].

entries.question: My VPN connection timed out
entries.answer:
If you are getting a connection timed out error on your VPN, try the following steps:
1. Switch networks, such as from home Wi-Fi to a mobile hotspot [1].
2. In the client, change the gateway from vpn-sg.acme.example to vpn-us.acme.example or the other way around [1].
3. If you are on a public or hotel network that blocks VPN traffic, use a hotspot [1].

entries.question: Can I install Zoom on my laptop?
entries.answer: Yes, Zoom can be installed by any employee from Software Center on a company laptop [1].

entries.question: How do I request Adobe Creative Cloud?
entries.answer: To request Adobe Creative Cloud, submit a helpdesk request that includes the software name, a business reason, and your manager's name [1].

entries.question: I cannot connect to the Acme-Corp Wi-Fi
entries.answer:
Here are the steps to fix connection issues with Acme-Corp Wi-Fi:
1. Turn Wi-Fi off and on again, and make sure Airplane mode is off [1].
2. Open Wi-Fi settings, select Acme-Corp, choose Forget, then reconnect [1].
3. Enter your domain email and your current password (use your new one if you changed it recently) [1].
4. Restart the laptop and try again [1].

entries.question: How do visitors get on the guest Wi-Fi?
entries.answer: Acme-Guest is for visitors, and reception gives out a new access code every day [1].

entries.question: My print job is stuck in the queue
entries.answer:
1. Open Printers and scanners, select your printer, and open the print queue [1].
2. Cancel all documents [1].
3. If the queue will not clear, open the Services app, find Print Spooler, and choose Restart, then try printing again [1].

entries.question: How do I add a printer?
entries.answer: To add a printer: 1. Open Settings, go to Printers and scanners, click Add device, and select the printer by its name [1]. 2. If it is not listed, click The printer I want is not listed and enter the name shown on the printer label [1].

entries.question: I got a new phone, how do I move my authenticator?
entries.answer: Set up the app on the new phone before you wipe or return the old phone [1]. Open the self-service MFA page, remove the old device, and add the new one [1].

entries.question: I lost my phone and cannot get MFA codes
entries.answer: I'm sorry to hear you lost your phone. Please contact the IT Service Desk as soon as possible so an agent can verify your identity with your employee ID and manager's name and reset your MFA registration [1].

entries.question: I cannot get into my account because it says it is locked
entries.answer: After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account locks for 30 minutes and unlocks automatically [1]. To unlock it sooner, you can use the self-service reset page or contact the IT Service Desk [1]. If your account stays locked after 30 minutes or you suspect someone else accessed it, please escalate to the Security team [2].

entries.question: I am at home and cannot open any internal company websites
entries.answer:
To troubleshoot when you cannot open internal company websites while connected to the VPN, try the following steps:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN [1].
2. Open Command Prompt and run `ipconfig /flushdns` [1].
3. Try opening the site by its full address, for example intranet.acme.example [1].

entries.question: I need design software for my new project at work
entries.answer: Adobe Creative Cloud is restricted and requires manager approval [4]. To request it, submit a helpdesk request including the software name, a business reason, and your manager's name [4]. Your manager will approve it by email within 2 business days, and IT will provision the license within 1 business day after approval [4].

entries.question: The internet at my desk is really slow and keeps cutting out
entries.answer:
To troubleshoot a slow or dropping Wi-Fi connection, try the following steps:
1. Move closer to an access point, avoid crowded areas (such as the cafeteria at lunch), and close heavy downloads [2].
2. Check whether coworkers nearby are experiencing the same issue [2].

entries.question: The office printer says it is not available
entries.answer:
If your printer says it is not available (offline), try the following steps:
1. Check that your laptop is on the Acme-Corp network [1].
2. Remove the printer and add it again [1]. To add it, open Settings, go to Printers and scanners, click Add device, and select the printer by its name. If it is not listed, click 'The printer I want is not listed' and enter the name shown on the printer label [4]

entries.question: The login codes from my phone app keep getting refused
entries.answer:
If your login codes keep getting refused, try the following steps:
1. Set your phone to automatic date and time, as wrong clock settings cause rejected codes [2][3].
2. Wait for the next code to appear and type it without delay [3].
3. If push approvals do not arrive, open the app manually and use the code instead [3].
